about: Patron perk STAT rows (data, Backend 2026-10-12): the quantities a perk template can move, one row per stat, keyed by id. benefit: which way is good for the holder (1 = more is good, -1 = less is good); text: the word the Exchange's book prints for it. A row here lets a template NAME the stat and the reader accept it; it does not by itself make any fight read it: resolvePerk returns the per-mille delta for every stat row, but only a combat reader that takes that field changes a fight. Today no code outside patrons.ts reads these fields.
